 Follow Harrison Ford, 84, and Calista Flockhart, 62, turn heads with age-defying appearance in matching outfits
 Maria Sarabi Thu, November 19, 2026 at 10:16 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart attend the Women's Guild Cedars-Sinai Stardust Ball at Beverly Wilshire (Getty Images) Harrison Ford and his wife, Calista Flockhart , enjoyed a date night at the Women's Guild Cedars-Sinai Stardust Ball at the Beverly Wilshire Hotel in Beverly Hills, California, on November 18, which HELLO!  attended.
 The couple, who were honored with the Hollywood Icon Award, coordinated their sartorial agenda for the evening. The award marked the first time the spouses have received a special tribute together. 
 Harrison looked suave in a navy tailored suit that was layered over a pale blue shirt and styled with a navy polka-dot tie. Meanwhile, Calista looked radiant in a black gown that featured long sleeves and a high neckline. The dress boasted draped detailing adorned with a gold band to cinch the waist. The ensemble was completed with gold jewelry and a black croc-effect clutch. 
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart attend the Women's Guild Cedars-Sinai Stardust Ball at Beverly Wilshire (@ Getty Images)
 Calista's hair was styled into soft waves with her classic bob cut while her makeup oozed glam, courtesy of a bronze eye and a rosy lip.

 The couple were honored with an award together (@ Getty Images)
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart's love story
 The Indiana Jones actor and the Ally McBeal  star first met at the 2002 Golden Globes and the pair eventually tied the knot with a private ceremony in Santa Fe, New Mexico in 2010. 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Despite their 22-year age gap, Calista has previously spoken out about how it was never a concern. "It doesn't faze me. Sometimes I even say, 'Wow, I keep forgetting that he's 22 years older than me'. It doesn't factor into our relationship at all," she told People . 
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart have a blended family (@ Getty Images)
 "I like the way he looks first thing in the morning. It's not handsome, it's more cute. He looks like a little boy." 
 The couple split their time between their sprawling ranch in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, and their luxurious mansion in Brentwood, California. Their stunning ranch in Wyoming that boasts over 800 acres of land.
 The property was purchased by Harrison back in the early 1980s. The couple also owns an eye-watering $13 million mansion in Brentwood, California. Harrison and Calista's son, Liam Flockhart, moved back in with his parents after graduating in 2023 from Amherst College in Massachusetts.
 Harrison Ford and Calista Flockhart reside in Wyoming (@ Getty Images)
 Blended family
 Harrison legally adopted Calista's 25-year-old son. He is also a father to four adult children from his previous marriages: Ben, 60, Willard, 57, Malcolm, 39, and Georgia, 36. In an interview with The Irish Times , Calista credited their successful marriage to the fact she was "really content" taking on the role of a full-time mum at home with their blended family.
